{{Breadcrumb Auto |overview=Stores and Unlocks |parent=Acquisition Center |title=Superstore |description=The rotating item shop in Helldivers 2 }} The '''Superstore''' is an item [[Stores and Unlocks|shop]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]'' accessible through the [[Acquisition Center]]. In it [[Armor|Armor sets]], [[Weapons]], and [[Cosmetics]] based on various [[Warbonds]] plus an extra [[#War Horses Superstore Page|War Horses]] set can be bought using {{Currency|SC}}.
